about:
Florida Torque Converter Corporation operates from Cape Coral, Florida, at 906 SE 9th Street. The company specializes in remanufacturing torque converters for automotive applications.

The company remanufactures torque converters using a process it calls blueprinting, where each component is inspected, machined, and balanced to exceed original specifications. Technicians keep original parts together throughout the process to maintain matched sets. The facility stocks thousands of converters for immediate shipment and offers custom stall-speed calibration for performance applications. Products cover OEM replacement, diesel performance, high-performance, and Jeep-specific units.

Customers include retail buyers purchasing online, wholesale distributors through a dedicated program, and enthusiasts seeking performance upgrades for diesel, high-performance, and Jeep vehicles. The company serves the automotive aftermarket across the United States.

Florida Torque Converter differentiates itself by its matched-part remanufacturing method, lifetime warranty on all units, and the ability to customize stall speeds to a vehicle's power curve. The blueprinting process aims to reduce vibration and extend component life beyond factory standards.
